notes.source: User request 2026-10-16: add map variety, 3x larger bounds, and deliberate lane bias by pushing one lane's bases forward and the others back.
notes.reason: halfWidth/halfDepth are roughly 3x config/standard-map.json (240x140 -> 720x420). The center lane's bases sit at x=+-300 (distance ~600 between them), far closer than the north/south lane bases at x=+-650 (distance ~1300). This makes the center a short, fast, contested corridor while the flanks require a long, sustained push - deliberate asymmetry across the 3 lanes, not a uniform map. Base/capture radii are left at the same unit-scale values as standard-map.json (weapon range/move speed are unchanged by map size, so these radii describe unit-to-unit interaction distances, not the battlefield scale). No obstacles authored yet; this map starts simple like the original P0 map did before FIELD-04 added walls, and can gain terrain later as a separate pass.
notes.stillTodo: No hand-authored obstacles/cover yet. Not yet wired into any in-game map-selection flow; today map choice is made by pointing the Editor's map TextAsset reference at this file instead of standard-map.json (see docs/MAP_VARIATIONS.md).
